results.name: Stagecoach
results.prompt: Image 1 is a finished card illustration from the game. Edit it: replace ONLY the main object with a red and yellow western stagecoach with high wheels, curved roof, luggage rack and empty front shafts. Change the environment to: sunny main street with dusty road, wooden storefronts and pale mesas in the distance, in the same simplified style. Keep exactly: the rendering style, lighting, camera angle, the object's size and position in the frame, the depth of field and the amount of detail. The new object must be complete, symmetric and physically correct, no extra or fused parts. No text, no people, no animals.

defects: Only one wheel is visible on each side; a stagecoach-style coach would normally have front and rear wheel pairs, so the second axle/wheels are missing or impossibly hidden.
The passenger door is on the front face directly above the horse shafts; real carriages usually have side doors and a driver/bench at the front, making the construction impractical.
The two forward shafts are unsupported at their front ends and have no crossbar or harness connection.
Left and right wheel/spoke shapes are slightly mismatched.
Partially visible underside wheel is much smaller than the other wheels and is oddly positioned, making the wheel set look inconsistent.
Pulling shafts extend forward with no visible yoke or connector and appear to attach awkwardly to the underside rather than a clear front axle assembly.
Far-side wheels are missing or hidden inconsistently for a four-wheeled coach.
